meta.name: json-canvas
meta.description: Create and edit JSON Canvas files (.canvas) with nodes, edges, groups, and connections. Use when working with .canvas files, creating visual canvases, mind maps, flowcharts, or when the user mentions Canvas files in Obsidian.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 创建和编辑 JSON Canvas 文件，构建可视化画布
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在 Obsidian 中创建和编辑 .canvas 文件
copy.tagline_en: Create and edit JSON Canvas files for visual canvases
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to create and edit .canvas files in Obsidian

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能直接生成和编辑 .canvas 文件：按规范写好节点（文本、文件、链接、分组）、连线，并给出完整的 JSON 内容。
howto.when: 当你要求创建或修改 .canvas 文件，或提到思维导图、流程图等画布时触发。

say.text: 帮我创建一个 .canvas 文件，放一个文本节点和一个文件节点，用箭头连起来。
画一个流程图：开始、判断、结束三个节点，用边连好。
say.note: 会生成带节点和边的 .canvas JSON。

say.text: 给这个画布加一个分组，把两个节点框进去。
say.note: Claude 会修改现有 .canvas 内容。

howto.what_en: Lets the agent create and edit .canvas files: it writes nodes (text, file, link, group), edges, and other fields as valid JSON Canvas data.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user works with .canvas files or asks for mind maps, flowcharts, or similar visual canvases.

say_en.text: Create a .canvas file with a text node and a file node, connected by an arrow.
say_en.note: The agent will output valid JSON Canvas content.

say_en.text: Make a flowchart with start, decision, and end nodes, linked by edges.
say_en.note: Generates .canvas JSON with nodes and edges.

say_en.text: Add a group around two nodes in this canvas.
say_en.note: The agent will edit the existing .canvas content.
